feature: Session-owned terminal picker and inspector transport

cases.title: Session terminal inspector opens only after deliberate picker selection
stimulus: invoke the terminal inspector palette command

oracles.expected: route changes to the selected PTY identity only after selection
selection performs no Session interrupt, PTY write, resize, or termination

negative: background PTY activity does not open or focus the inspector

cases.title: terminal picker excludes PTYs owned by another Session and safely retries list failure
preconditions: list response contains owned and foreign Session fixtures

oracles.expected: only owned PTYs render and list failure has a retry action
Promise Client list request includes the active Session id and Location

negative: foreign PTY and raw transport error details never render
cleanup: abort list request and dispose renderer

cases.title: ticketed control connection carries generation offset and writer fence
preconditions: user control is synchronized at a known fence

oracles.expected: public connect-token input and socket query bind PTY, Session, Location, generation, offset, access, and fence
binary server frame reaches the inspector exactly once

negative: input is not sent before the fenced control socket is open
cleanup: close socket and abort ticket request

cases.title: socket reconnect resumes the resident emulator from its last ordered offset
preconditions: ordered output has advanced the resident emulator

oracles.expected: next connection requests the same generation and last applied offset
prior cells remain while connection status recovers

negative: reconnect neither clears the emulator nor replays already applied bytes

cases.title: connect-token failure settles as a safe reconnectable transport failure
preconditions: connect-token request rejects with sensitive diagnostic detail

oracles.expected: one category-only connection failure reaches the inspector

negative: raw error text and ticket material do not reach rendering

cases.title: closing during ticket acquisition cancels transport without opening a late socket

oracles.expected: request signal is aborted and no WebSocket remains
late token response creates zero sockets

negative: cancel does not interrupt the Session or terminate the PTY
cleanup: settle deferred promise and assert zero live sockets

cases.title: close-view retains inspector when returning user control fails

oracles.expected: inspector remains open with user ownership unchanged
safe actionable control failure is visible

negative: view does not close, resume agent control, interrupt Session, terminate PTY, or render raw error details
